ingredients: Cheese spread: 12 oz whipped cream cheese
Burger: thinly sliced onion and jalapeño
instructions: Cheese spread: mix everything together and refrigerate for 30 minutes or more until ready to serve.

title: Smashburger with Cheese Spread

instructions: In a medium bowl, whisk together the yogurt, buttermilk, and sour cream until smooth.
Add garlic powder, onion powder, and salt.
Stir in the parsley, dill, and chives.
Add lemon juice, starting with 1 tsp, and adjust to taste.
Chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes.
Serve as a dip or dressing.
title: Healthy Homemade Ranch

ingredients: Mayo: 2 tsp lemon juice or vinegar
Ranch: 2 tbsp each fresh dill, parsley, and chives, finely chopped
Ranch: 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder
instructions: Mayo: in a bowl or using an immersion blender, whisk the egg yolks, mustard, and lemon juice until smooth.
Mayo: slowly drizzle in the oil while whisking constantly until thick and emulsified.
Mayo: season with salt.
Ranch: whisk mayo, sour cream, and buttermilk until smooth.
Ranch: stir in seasonings and whisk to combine.
Ranch: adjust consistency with buttermilk and flavor with lemon juice.
Ranch: chill for 30 minutes before serving. Tastes even better the next day.
title: Homemade Ranch Dressing (With Homemade Mayo)

ingredients: Sandwich toppings: Colby Jack and mozzarella cheese blend
instructions: Preheat the grill: get a chimney of coals hot, dump into the tray, and let the cast iron sit over the coals for about 10 minutes.
Cube the chuck and season with salt + pepper. Add about 2 tbsp olive oil to the pot and sear the cubes, flipping occasionally, until all sides get a good sear.
Blend all the remaining ingredients (except bay leaves) in a blender or food processor, then dump into the pot. Add the bay leaves and close the lid.
After about 4 hours, the chuck should have reached 200°F+ and be pull-apart tender. Separate the consommé from the beef.
Remove the pot, set a new round of coals, and place a skillet on the tray. Butter the skillet and toast the bread, then build the sandwich. Cut and dip in consommé and cilantro.
title: Beef Barbacoa Grilled Cheese

ingredients: 1 tsp each cumin and dried cilantro
7 oz chipotle peppers in adobo sauce
instructions: Season the chuck roast with salt, pepper, and garlic powder. Heat a skillet over medium-high heat with a couple of tbsp of butter and sear the roast on all sides.

Put the roast in a slow cooker. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, chili powder, and cayenne. Add the onion, beef broth, minced garlic, green chiles, and chipotle peppers in adobo. Stir together.
Cook on low for 7 or 8 hours. Remove the meat, shred with two forks, and discard extra fat.
Carefully add the juices and chipotle peppers from the slow cooker to a blender. Blend the sauce and set aside.
Heat a skillet over medium heat with some oil. Lay out tortillas, top with shredded cheese and a spoonful of meat. Fold and cook on both sides until golden brown and crispy.
Lay tacos on paper towels to absorb extra grease. Top with your favorite toppings and dip in the sauce.
title: Crockpot Chipotle Shredded Beef Tacos

ingredients: 1/3 cup oil (avocado oil or bacon grease)
instructions: In a large bowl, combine all the dry ingredients, then add in the wet. Combine until well mixed and it turns into a dough.
Cover the dough with a warm towel and let it sit for 30 minutes.
Shape the dough into small balls, put back into the bowl, and re-cover with a new warm towel for 15 minutes. Flour your surfaces.
Set a pan over medium-ish heat. Roll out the balls on a floured surface and cook each one 30 seconds to a minute on each side, keeping an eye on them.
Store in a ziplock bag in the fridge for up to a week.
title: Flour Tortillas

ingredients: Low-salt option: onion powder, garlic powder, pepper, and smoked paprika instead of the AP seasoning
instructions: Set oven to 300°F.
Score hot dogs in a cross-stitch pattern to get the pinecone look.
Lather on mustard/mayo and season with AP seasoning first, then smoked paprika.
Place dogs on a warming rack and cook 30–45 minutes, or until the crust sets and the hot dogs open up.
On the stovetop, combine butter, brown sugar, and Gold sauce and mix.
Cut dogs into thirds, place in a cast iron skillet scored-side up, and evenly lather on the BBQ mixture.
Increase oven temp to 350°F and let the pinecones sit another 30 minutes, or until you're satisfied with the char.
Remove and let sit about 10 minutes. Enjoy.
title: Hot Dog Pinecones

ingredients: Beef: 1 heaped tbsp tomato puree (tomato paste)
Seasoning: 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder, oregano
Seasoning: 1/2 tsp each sugar, cayenne pepper
Tacos: favorite taco toppings (lettuce, tomato, avocado, etc.)
instructions: Preheat oven to 200°C / 400°F.

Add oil to a large pan over medium-high heat and add the beef. Break it up, and when it begins to brown, stir in the seasoning and continue frying until cooked. Add tomato puree and water and fry another minute until the water soaks up and the beef is thick and juicy. If you have time, leave to cool until it stops steaming.

Line 2 baking trays with baking paper. Slice one pastry sheet into 8 even rectangles, then slice 2 more out of the second sheet. Sprinkle the cheese in 10 mounds in the same shape as the pastry (just a bit smaller), then top with beef. Place the pastry over the top, press around the outside to secure the filling, and brush with egg wash.
Bake 15 minutes, or until deep golden and crispy. Meanwhile, make the sauce by combining sour cream + sriracha.
Flip the pastries over (slide a spatula underneath; if the paper sticks, cut around each pastry, flip individually, and remove the paper). Add toppings and enjoy.
title: Upside Down Puff Pastry Tacos

instructions: Brown the breakfast sausage in a pan, then set aside to cool.
Chop the pepper jack cheese and Velveeta into cubes about 1 inch wide.
Add the cubes of cheese to the bottom of an oven-safe dish and place the block of cream cheese on top.
Pour in both cans of Ro-Tel, then add the crumbled breakfast sausage.
Sprinkle the chopped cilantro over the top, season with taco seasoning, then pour in 8 oz of beer.
Smoke at 300°F for about an hour, then stir until well combined and smoke for 30 more minutes.
Serve immediately alongside tortilla chips or crackers.
title: Smoked Texas Queso

ingredients: 2 chipotles in adobo sauce plus 1 tsp sauce
1 jalapeño, cut into chunks (leave seeds in, or remove them)
1 tsp guajillo chili powder (or any chili powder)
instructions: Combine chilis, garlic, onion, and jalapeño in a food processor and pulse until roughly chopped.
Add tomatoes, lime juice, cilantro, chili powder, and salt. Continue to pulse until uniform but still slightly chunky.
Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary.
Serve with tortilla chips, on eggs, or on tacos.
title: 5-Minute Salsa

ingredients: Rub amounts are per 5 lbs of meat
A few tbsp red pepper flakes (optional)
instructions: Rub and coat the entire slab of meat, then place in sealed, airtight bags for 7 days, flipping them over every day.
After 7 days, pull out of the bags and rinse under water well. Pat dry and add any additional seasonings if desired.
Place in the smoker at 160–170°F for around 6 hours, or until the meat reaches 155°F internal temp. (Or bake in the oven at 200°F until it reaches 155°F internal.)
Take off the smoker, place back in the fridge uncovered until fully cooled. Then slice and package.
title: Homemade Bacon (Rub & Cure)

instructions: Cook the bacon and sausage, and make scrambled eggs.
Slice Hawaiian rolls in half and add American cheese to the bottom of the rolls.
Add browned sausage and scrambled eggs, and top with shredded Colby Jack cheese.
Top with crispy bacon and put the tops of the Hawaiian rolls on.
In a bowl, mix melted butter and syrup. Brush this on top of the rolls.
Sprinkle Everything but the Bagel seasoning on top.
Bake at 350°F for about 15 minutes.
Serve with extra syrup for dipping.
title: Breakfast Sliders

ingredients: Topping: whipped cream and extra caramel
instructions: Fill your blender with the ice cubes, caramel sauce, milk, and espresso.
Blend, then pour into your final cup.
Top with whipped cream and extra caramel if you like.
title: Caramel Frappuccino
Easy Chicken Enchiladas
ingredients: 1 (10.5 ounce) can cream of chicken soup
3 chicken breasts, pre-cooked & cut up (or use a rotisserie chicken)
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°F.
Combine sour cream, soup, and chilies in a bowl.
Take 3/4 cup of the soup mixture and slather the entire bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish. This thin layer keeps the enchiladas from sticking.
In each tortilla, layer soup mixture, cheese, and chicken.
Roll up and place in the casserole dish.
Top with the remaining soup mixture and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake for 20 minutes or until hot and bubbly and the cheese is melted.

title: Smoky Ranch Skillet Potatoes
instructions: Add potatoes and oil to a medium skillet. Cook over medium to medium-high heat until the potatoes are tender and getting golden and crispy.
Once the potatoes are mostly cooked and browned, add ranch seasoning, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, and salt. Toss and cook 3 to 5 minutes.
During the last minute, add butter. Toss until melted and the potatoes are well coated.
After turning off the heat, add fresh chives and lemon juice. Taste and add more salt or lemon if needed.

title: Easy Bolognese
ingredients: 1 lb wide pasta noodles, such as pappardelle or tagliatelle
instructions: In a large saucepan, heat olive oil over medium heat.
Add in carrots along with celery and onions and sauté until they're just tender, about 3 minutes.
Add the ground beef and ground pork, and cook until browned, breaking up the meat as you stir.
Pour in the jar of store-bought marinara sauce and white wine along with salt and pepper and simmer for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until sauce thickens.

When the Bolognese sauce has reached your desired consistency, stir in the heavy cream. Remove from heat, and serve over your favorite pasta — we like to use pappardelle or tagliatelle — and top with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

title: Banana Bread
ingredients: 1 1/2 tsp lemon juice, to keep bananas from turning brown
instructions: Preheat oven to 350°. Grease loaf pans and coat with sugar.
Mash bananas and stir in lemon juice (decide how many loaves you can make with the bananas you have).
Cream butter and sugar in large mixer bowl.
Add eggs and beat on medium speed for 3 minutes.
Add dry ingredients and mix on medium speed about 1 minute.
Add bananas and mix well.
Stir in nuts if desired.
Turn into prepared pans and bake at 350° for 45 minutes, or until done if baking a loaf or 20-25 minutes if making muffins.
Dump out of pans and cool on wire rack.
